Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Diamond Dreams Jewelry specializes in the retail sale of high-quality fine jewelry and watches, including engagement rings, necklaces, bracelets, and custom pieces. Our store emphasizes exceptional customer service and expert consultations to meet the unique needs of our clients. We maintain an extensive inventory valued over $500,000, secured by a professionally monitored alarm system. Additionally, we offer minor repair services for jewelry, which constitute less than 25% of our total sales. We strictly adhere to industry regulations and do not engage in the sale of high-risk products, ensuring a safe and compliant shopping environment for our customers.

the following restrictions apply:

professionally monitored alarm system installed and maintained. This reduces theft risk and
supports claims validation.
• Repair and Installation Work Limitations: Repair, installation, or assembly work must
be minor and comprise less than 25% of total receipts. This restriction limits exposure to
liability claims from faulty workmanship or accidents during service calls.
